messages:
maria_devex: Heads up — after yesterday's console rollout we got a couple of user reports where py-sdk v1.8.0 clients show up in the console with no routing/quota headers during init. Repro below, minimal app that triggers it when run in gunicorn gevent workers:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), sampling_enabled=True)
# background sampler starts and sometimes sends before headers applied
resp = client.generate('hello')
```
maria_devex: I can reproduce locally with --workers=4 and concurrent startup. Missing header seems to cause quota attribution to fall back to default bucket.
alex_platform: yikes. thanks for the report. is this only py-sdk? any TS/Go hits?
sam_engineering: quick check: this smells like an init race — we spawn the sampling thread in __init__ and it uses the transport before route headers are attached by middleware. I've seen similar with pre-fork webservers.
jenna_sre: @sam_engineering can you share a stack snippet? if it's pre-fork, we should avoid starting background threads before fork or ensure lazy-start after worker bootstrap.
sam_engineering: stack trace (short):
```
Thread sampling-thread:
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/threading.py", line 980, in _bootstrap_inner
  File "/opt/app/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/redwood/client.py", line 212, in _sampler_loop
    self._transport.send(headers=self._default_headers, body=payload)
```
sam_engineering: _default_headers is still {} because Client._attach_route_headers() hasn't run yet (it's executed by the request middleware when the first user request initializes route negotiation).
alex_platform: ok that explains it. two levers: 1) server-side tolerate missing headers (map to tenant-level default) 2) quick client hotfix: attach conservative headers at import time or defer sampler until after middleware handshake.
maria_devex: can we do a minimal hotfix for 1.8.x? users on pinned versions are impacted.
alex_platform: server-side fallback is low-risk. ops: if header missing, attribute to the "unrouted" quota bucket and emit a metric. but we'd still want client fix.
jenna_sre: I'll patch the fallback in routing-service canary tomorrow, emit metric `quota.attr.missing_route` so we can measure. schedule on canary region only.
observability-bot: [metric] quota.attr.missing_route +1 (canary region)
sam_engineering: for client patch I propose a tiny change: don't start sampler in __init__, instead provide start_sampler() called by client.ready() or lazily start on first outbound request. quick patch diff: 
```diff
- self._start_sampler()
+ # avoid starting background thread until route headers are configured
+ if not os.environ.get('RW_PREFORK'):
+     self._start_sampler()
```
sam_engineering: and add a doc note about gunicorn/gevent pre-fork pattern in upgrade guide.
alex_platform: that seems fine. Keep it opt-in with env var until we validate. Also add detection to warn when running under gunicorn pre-fork.
maria_devex: can we get a 1.8.1 patch with the sampler change + release note? I'll coordinate messaging.
sam_engineering: putting up PR now: #4892. tests added for pre-fork simulation (spawn + fork).
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: routing-service/canary -> v2.14.3 at 2025-10-02T09:00:00Z
observability-bot: [alert] quota.attr.missing_route rate 0.02 -> 0.12 (canary)
alex_platform: the canary bump looks healthy but a few hits — expected. we'll keep the server fallback in place for one week.
jenna_sre: can we also add a console UX signal to list "unattributed" request examples so customer success can triage?
maria_devex: yes — create a console tile to surface top endpoints with missing headers, link to upgrade doc. I'll file the ticket.
sam_engineering: merged PR and cut 1.8.1rc. tag: py-sdk v1.8.1-rc1.
maria_devex: thanks everyone. i'll post a short note in #announcements once 1.8.1 is promoted and when server fallback is removed.
alex_platform: follow-up action: (1) sam to open SDK postmortem blurb; (2) jenna to monitor metric and remove fallback after 7 days if <0.01 rate; (3) devex to publish gunicorn guide.
maria_devex: recorded actions noted. closing thread once 1.8.1 live. :thumbsup:
